Besides the Best Buy 60th anniversary deals, this week's discounts on AirPods Pro 3 by 25%, all five colors of AirPods Max 2 by $120, and AirTag 2 at its historical low price are still ongoing, but today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break also has several new deals worth noting. If you act fast, the official Apple Refurbished Store just got restocked, with the cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Pro reduced to $1,099, available in Midnight Black, Starlight, and Sky Blue. We've also found multiple brand-new M5 Pro MacBook Pro models with $400 off. The $100 discount on Apple Watch Series 11 has also returned, starting at just over $250. We also have deals on Twelve South accessories — including their Find My charger and Curve Nano MagSafe stand — both at new Amazon lows. All deals listed below.

AirPods discounts drop again, now up to $120 off: AirPods Pro 3 down 25%, and more

After a summer of steady discounts across Apple's latest AirPods lineup, prices have dropped even further on nearly every model. The ever-popular AirPods Pro 3 are now down 25%, among their lowest prices ever. The AirPods 4 with ANC have also hit their lowest price in months, while the AirPods Max 2 dropped another $120 this morning.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (original price $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (original price $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (original price $129)

AirTag 2 back at historical low price, starting from $22 each (four-pack and single)

  • AirTag 2 $24 (original price $29) | Amazon
  • AirTag 2 $24 (original price $29) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 "Excellent" open-box $20 (original price $29) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 four-pack $89 (original price $99)

Best Buy anniversary one-day LG deals: TVs from $330, $600 off 2026 OLED models, and more

Restock alert: Cheapest M5 MacBook Air back to $1,099 at Apple Refurbished, act fast (brand new models down $200)

Update 8/20: This deal is now restocked back at $1,099, in Midnight Black, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This deal will very likely end soon — it always does — but the official Apple Refurbished Store just restocked the cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Pro, down to $1,099 with free shipping, in Midnight Black, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

Every time Apple restocks this configuration, it sells out quickly, so if you're interested, don't miss out — this is after all the lowest price for an M5 MacBook Air.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is now selling the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air at $1,099, with 16GB RAM and 512GB storage, including free shipping. As mentioned above, as of writing, Midnight Black, Starlight, and Sky Blue are still in stock.

This machine's original price is $1,299, now $200 less than the brand new model.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (original price $1,299)
  • Midnight Black, Starlight, and Sky Blue

A reminder that all products at the official Apple Refurbished Store come with the following coverage:

  • Apple one-year limited warranty
  • Apple 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare available for purchase
  • Sold only after passing Apple's strict refurbishment process

For comparison, the same brand new model on Amazon is priced very close to the $1,299 MSRP, with the Silver model down to $1,240.

Amazon still has select M5 Pro MacBook Pro configurations down $400

As part of its 60th anniversary celebration yesterday, Best Buy ran a one-day special Apple deal, with the spotlight on two M5 Pro MacBook Pro configurations at $400 off, but if you missed it, Amazon still has the same two deals today.

Amazon is still selling these two 14-inch 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro models for $400 below MSRP — one with the base CPU/GPU specs, the other upgraded to an 18-core CPU and 12-core configuration.

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,599 (original price $2,999) 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,799 (original price $3,199) 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU

These are indeed the same deals we recommended yesterday, but back then it seemed like they would only last one day — Best Buy said so too, and there's no way to know whether Amazon would follow suit. Overall, Amazon could end these deals at any time, but as of writing they're still active, and we wanted to make sure you know about it.

This 48GB 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro is down $400 today

B&H is now selling the Apple 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro at $2,699 with free shipping, equipped with 48GB RAM and 1TB storage.

This $3,099 configuration is $400 cheaper than buying directly from Apple.

Apple Watch Series 11 anniversary deal down $100, Best Buy open-box from $254

Although yesterday's 24-hour limited 60th anniversary Apple deal has ended, there are still many great deals. Besides the AirPods Pro 3 down 25%, AirPods Max 2 down $120, and Apple's latest AirTag 2 returning to its historical low price, we've also found that all the cheapest Apple Watch Series 11 models on Amazon and Best Buy are down $100 — you can even find "Excellent" open-box versions as low as $254.

Amazon is once again selling all base 46mm Series 11 models at $329 with free shipping, $100 off the $429 MSRP, and all four case colors are available at this discounted price.

However, their smaller and cheaper 42mm versions are now almost completely sold out. That's where Best Buy can help.

They're running a week-long 60th anniversary celebration, with all 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 models in stock and priced $100 below MSRP.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (original price $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (original price $429)

Although the price difference isn't huge, I wanted to mention the "Excellent" open-box deal on the Jet Black 42mm model — you can get one for $253.99 with free shipping, $145 below the brand new MSRP. Compared to buying a brand new model right now which is only $45 less, but $45 isn't a small amount, and this is the lowest price we can find at a reputable retailer.

Amazon top-tier Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro models down $220 today (matching Prime Day deals)

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (original price $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (original price $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (original price $1,499)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (original price $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (original price $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (original price $1,299)

As detailed in yesterday's Apple Refurbished Store feature, you can get a fully functional iPhone 16 starting from $699, with a one-year Apple warranty; while the 1TB 16 Pro Max is priced at $1,269 — $330 cheaper than a comparable 17 Pro Max, and $130 cheaper than the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 from $699 (up to $330 cheaper than the 17 series)

Twelve South Curve Nano is one of the most beautiful MagSafe stands I've seen, starting at $27 (original price $35)

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Twelve South multi-purpose fabric PowerCord USB-C charger now down to $16.50 (45% off)
  • 5TB for only $180? Rare deal drops WD Elements external hard drive to lowest price since storage price hikes (today only)
  • Woot latest deals: Keychron mechanical keyboards from $20, up to 64% off
  • This 14-in-1 Anker Prime docking station is down $100, new low price
  • This Anker 8-outlet USB surge protector power strip is $22 today
  • Upgrade your home theater with the Govee TV Backlight 3 Lite set for responsive lighting effects, from $110, more models from $60
  • Petcube Cam 360 offers 360-degree pet monitoring and two-way talk for just $35
  • Govee's latest Floor Lamp 3 Lite supports Matter, from $85, or other models up to 47% off, from $80
  • Anker Nano 100W three-port charger with 5-foot cable, $36 today

Amazon now has all five AirPods Max 2 colors down $120 (one of the best prices ever)

This week's 60th anniversary celebration has brought one of the best prices ever for the Apple 2026 AirPods Max 2, with Amazon now offering all five colors at $120 off.

Amazon is now selling the Apple AirPods Max 2 at $429 with free shipping.

Priced the same as the previous generation at $549, saving $120, it's the lowest brand new price we can currently find at a reputable retailer.

Best Buy does have a Midnight Black "Excellent" open-box version, priced at $403.99 with free shipping, which is cheaper, but may not be cheap enough to make you give up the brand new model.

Apple launched a true next-generation AirPods Max this year, not just a new color version with a USB-C port added. Unlike the in-ear AirPods lineup, their over-ear model won't be updated at next month's new product launch, so this week we can get this product at $120 off — it may well be Apple's newest and best over-ear headphones in the short term.

Only one promotional event ever had a lower price — this summer's Prime Day, when the price was $30 lower than today's deal price — and that 4-day promotional event had fairly limited and unstable stock.

Anker 45W Nano smart display charger holds steady at $26 low, but this bundle costs just $4 more and includes a USB-C cable

As part of the ongoing 60th anniversary celebration, Best Buy is selling the white Anker 45W Nano smart display charger at $29.99 with free shipping, plus a Nano USB-C cable. This is only about $4 more than the charger's current discounted price of $25.99 with free shipping at both Amazon and Best Buy. Considering the included Nano USB-C cable typically costs around $18, you're essentially paying just $4 to add the cable — a very worthwhile choice. See below for more details.

  • Anker Nano 45W GaN smart display charger $25.99 (original price $40)
  • Black
  • Blue
  • Orange
  • White

The Anker 45W Nano charger features a built-in smart display that can identify supported devices (such as iPhone and iPad Pro models) and automatically adjust power delivery. The screen also displays real-time charging information and animations, so you can see the charging status as soon as you plug in a device. It features a top-mounted USB-C port that delivers up to 45W output, plus 180-degree foldable prongs, making it convenient to carry whether for daily use or travel. Anker offers four colors, including an orange that matches Apple's Cosmic Orange devices nicely. This special deal adds an Anker Nano USB-C cable for just $4 more. This fabric cable supports up to 240W charging and 480Mb/s data transfer, making it an overall solid choice — if you're looking for a new reliable cable to charge your phone, this is definitely a good buy.

Other Anker deals worth noting

  • Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 MagSafe foldable charger $100 (original price $150)
  • Anker Prime 3-in-1 25W Qi2.2 charging stand with display $135 (original price $230)
  • Anker 160W 3-port Prime charger with display and touch controls $116 (original price $150)
